title: NOW THEY'VE CROSSED THE LINE
tags: the culture war with tim pool
description:
Democrats and outside groups are under fire as controversial ads and mailers in Virginia’s redistricting battle are accused of misleading voters. Critics say the messaging is designed to confuse the public ahead of a high-stakes vote that could shift multiple congressional seats in the midterms. With power on the line, both sides are pouring money into aggressive campaigns as accusations of misinformation intensify.
